paragraph: [In May 2026 civil registration posts in Luanda and most of the country had been without their system for months](<https://www.novojornal.co.ao/politica/detalhe/minjusdh-diz-que-falhas-do-sistema-nos-postos-de-identificacao-e-registo-civil-que-ja-duram-ha-meses-se-devem-as-quebras-de-telecomunicacoes-71601.html>). The Justice Ministry blamed telecom breakdowns. In the last twelve months, [Angola told a registrars' meeting in July 2026 that it is merging the civil register and the identity card system](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-digitisation-angola.pdf>), on the existing civil registry system. [The 2023-2024 survey put registration of children under five at 38%](<https://novojornal.co.ao/sociedade/detalhe/no-pais-menos-de-quatro-criancas-em-cada-10-estao-registadas-65688.html>), a figure not tied to a digital system. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[In August 2026 ID Tech reported that 13 municipalities in Burundi have biometric civil registration systems](<https://idtechwire.com/burundi-extends-biometric-civil-registration-toward-national-digital-id/>). [The Ministry of the Interior has presented a digital platform for managing civil registration](<https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/burundi-launches-digital-civil-registry-and-biometric-id-initiative>), with its infrastructure nearly complete and a decree governing its use awaited. In the last twelve months, the August 2026 report of 13 communes is the widest coverage found. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[ANIP says Law 2020-34 of January 2021 abolished paper civil registers](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-2-Benin-FINAL.pdf>), and every birth is now registered in the national register of persons. [Since May 2026 secure birth certificates have been issued from its data](<https://lepotentiel.bj/2026/05/06/enrolement-au-rnpp-et-delivrance-des-actes-de-naissance-securises-au-benin-lanip-precise-les-nouvelles-directives/>). In the last twelve months, [ANIP's 2026 slides say a death declared by a health worker or local chief is registered automatically](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T4-1-S2-3-Benin-FINAL.pdf>). [A single desk was piloted from August 2025 in ten public health facilities](<https://www.unicef.org/benin/recits/le-b%C3%A9nin-modernise-lenregistrement-des-naissances-avec-un-guichet-unique-digital>), and [ANIP says national scale-up is still to come](<https://www.unicef.org/benin/recits/b%C3%A9nin-journ%C3%A9e-de-l%C3%A9tat-civil-et-des-statistiques-de-l%C3%A9tat-civil-2026>). No source found since October 2023 puts birth registration at 90% or more. Mature would need a source from the past three years that puts the share of births registered in the digital system at 90% or more.

[In September 2026 delegated officers and transcribing agents in Pouni were trained on the VENEEM platform](<https://www.aib.media/sanguie-pouni-des-agents-de-letat-civil-outilles-a-lutilisation-de-la-plateforme-veneem/>), which takes real-time entry of births, marriages and deaths. In the last twelve months, [the Minister of Territorial Administration said 30 communes now hold fully digitised civil-status registers](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article144154>), as reported by the Primature. [AMADE Mondiale lists deployment of a digital birth registration platform among completed activities](<https://www.amade.org/en/missions/protection/civil-status-for-all/civil-registration-for-children-in-burkina-faso-oe-phase-ii.html>) of its 2025-2028 project in Kaya, Tenkodogo and Koupela. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[Statistics Botswana's 2024 report says the Births and Deaths Registration System dates from 2003](<https://statsbots.org.bw/sites/default/files/publications/Vital%20Statistics%20Report%202024.pdf>) and is only partly automated. It runs through 35 district offices and 17 on-site registration points, and part of the work is still done by hand. [UNICEF said in December 2024 that Botswana has universal birth registration](<https://www.unicef.org/zimbabwe/press-releases/birth-registration-steadily-increases-worldwide-150-million-children-still-invisible>), a figure not tied to the digital system. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[In February 2026 the EU-backed digitisation project run by CIVIPOL was extending its pilot in Bangui and towns on the main corridor to new communes](<https://oubanguimedias.com/2026/02/23/centrafrique-le-comite-technique-dappui-et-de-suivi-du-projet-dappui-a-la-modernisation-de-letat-civil-valide-les-activites-du-projet-modero/>). In the last twelve months, [the national civil register held more than 225,000 birth records in July 2026](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-digitisation-car.pdf>), and [agents trained that month started digitising old registers](<https://oubanguimedias.com/2026/07/20/centrafrique-le-matddl-lance-la-numerisation-des-documents-detat-civil-pour-securiser-lidentite-nationale/>). [On 17 November 2026 the steering committee named the civil-status software MbetiNet](<https://oubanguimedias.com/2026/11/19/modernisation-de-letat-civil-en-rca-des-avancees-significatives-malgre-des-defis-persistants/>). No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[In February 2026 ONECI said Cityweb was in all 692 civil registration centres](<https://www.koaci.com/article/2026/02/10/cote-divoire/societe/cote-divoire-le-delai-de-delivrance-de-la-carte-nationale-didentite-ramene-a-moins-de-deux-semaines-perspectives-de-la-structure-pour-2026_194217.html>). In the last twelve months, [ONECI issued its first CityWeb act from Madrid on 11 May 2026](<https://www.oneci.ci/actualites/1779110716>), and [in October 2026 it said CityWeb had been deployed in all the country's centres](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/etat-civil-le-cameroun-s-inspire-de-la-cote-d-ivoire-pour-interconnecter-ses-donnees>). Its director general [noted connectivity problems in some](<https://www.sikafinance.com/marches/cote-divoire-le-logiciel-national-detat-civil-deploye-la-connectivite-reste-un-defi_65266>). [AIP reports that Citiweb registers births, marriages and deaths](<https://www.aip.ci/cote-divoire-aip-digitalisation-de-letat-civil-les-sous-prefets-du-goh-mobilises-pour-accompagner-la-reforme-de-loneci/>). No source found since October 2023 puts birth registration at 90% or more. Mature would need a source from the past three years that puts the share of births registered in the digital system at 90% or more.

[In September 2026 the registration bureau BUNEC said 60 of 432 civil-registration centres were digitised](<https://ecomatin.net/cameroun-52-milliards-fcfa-recherches-pour-numeriser-letat-civil>). That is 13.9%, up from 42 in April 2022. In the last twelve months, [the statistics institute said in April 2026 that a December 2024 law creates a national civil-status file](<https://fr.allafrica.com/stories/202604210117.html>), and a test linking the register with health and statistics systems is under way. [In March 2026 NRC was piloting a digital office in Logone-Birni](<https://reliefweb.int/report/cameroon/securing-every-childs-identity-nrcs-efforts-strengthen-birth-registration-cameroon-nrc>). No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[In August 2025 four UN agencies were piloting DHIS2 in Masina commune, Kinshasa](<https://drc.unfpa.org/fr/news/rdc-masina-commune-pilote-pour-la-digitalisation-des-faits-de-letat-civil>), to record births, marriages and deaths. [A national contract with Afritech and Idemia covered a civil registration system](<https://actualite.cd/2024/09/04/rdc-le-contrat-carte-didentite-annule-apres-les-revelations-dactualitecd-lighthouse>). It was signed in December 2023 and cancelled in August 2024, and nothing has replaced it. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[In September 2026 ACSI, which built the SIFEC civil-status software, handed its technical documents to the territorial administration directorate](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/digitalisation-de-letat-civil-ladministration-du-territoire-receptionne-les-documents>). Data centralisation, user training and deployment were still to come. In the last twelve months, [the project head told the National Assembly's Ecofin committee in August 2026 that SIFEC computerises the national civil register](<https://fr.allafrica.com/stories/202608110263.html>). [On 17 November 2026 ACSI's director general told the committee SIFEC was ready](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/assemblee-nationale-lacsi-presente-letat-davancement-des-differents-projets-172444>). He named no offices using it. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[In October 2025 La Gazette des Comores reported the AMECC project coordinator saying civil registration is still largely manual](<https://www.lagazettedescomores.com/soci%C3%A9t%C3%A9/vers-un-%C3%A9tat-civil-num%C3%A9rique-moh%C3%A9li-ouvre-la-voie-%C3%A0-la-modernisation-nationale-.html>), and a digitisation study was launched on 10 October 2025. In the last twelve months, [Comores Droit said in March 2026 that births, marriages and deaths have been recorded in paper registers for decades](<http://comoresdroit.centerblog.net/2912-une-revolution-numerique-se-prepare-pour-l-etat-civil>). [In August 2026 La Gazette des Comores reported that the system still largely depends on old paper registers](<https://lagazettedescomores.com/soci%C3%A9t%C3%A9/%C3%A9tat-civil-l%E2%80%99amecc-veut-enterrer-les-registres-sur-papier-.html>). No source found since October 2023 names a digital civil register. Preparing would need a digital civil registration system procured, piloted or rolled out to some offices.

[The statistics institute says the registry directorate's services in Cabo Verde have been computerised with NOSi since 2004](<https://bdmi.ine.cv/site_deploy_api/Uploads/20251205_142245_cc7f58f7-2417-444c-9c21-07f670b19a7f.pdf>). Its count of 6,760 births registered in 2023 comes from that registration database, and deaths are drawn from the same database. In the last twelve months, [Biometric Update reported in May 2026 that birth registration reached 99 per cent](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202605/cabo-verdes-crvs-id-reforms-drive-near-universal-birth-registration>), up from about 91 per cent before the reforms. [IMIJ's ID4Africa 2026 deck gives about 99 to 100 per cent](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T4-1-S2-1-Cape-Verde-FINAL.pdf>), as the presenter's approximation. No change to the register itself has been found in that time.

[Ville de Djibouti says civil-status events in Djibouti city have been recorded on the SIGEC software since 2011](<https://villededjibouti.dj/actualite2.php?id=31>), with the database fed continuously. A diagnostic of it began on 28 April 2024. In the last twelve months, [the DGPF director general said in July 2026 that birth and marriage certificates are progressively being integrated into a digital database](<https://www.lanation.dj/notre-vision-est-de-faire-de-la-direction-generale-de-la-population-et-de-la-famille-une-administration-entierement-modernisee-interconnectee-et-proche-des-citoyens-abdi-abdillahi-obsie/>), as part of an archive digitisation programme. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[In 2010 the Interior Ministry launched a computerised civil-status system with a central database, the RNEC](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T2-3-S3-4-Algeria-FINAL.pdf>). [Birth registers were archived digitally](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T2-3-S3-4-Algeria-FINAL.pdf>), and [more than 100 million marriage, death and birth acts have been digitised, per La Sentinelle](<https://lasentinelle.dz/index.php/2024/04/04/une-revolution-dans-le-service-public/>). In the last twelve months, [in December 2025 the Interior Minister said administrations can consult civil status data directly in the national automated register](<https://www.algerie360.com/les-administrations-nont-plus-le-droit-dexiger-ces-documents-saayoud-promet-des-sanctions-severes/>). No source found since October 2023 says deaths are registered in the digital system. Operating would need deaths registered in the digital system, in service.

[In 2024 Egypt told the UN that live birth registration was an estimated 96.6 per cent complete in 2022](<https://unstats.un.org/unsd/demographic-social/products/dyb/documents/metadata/2024/Egypt-2024-VT-Metadata.pdf>), a figure too old to count. In the last twelve months, [Egypt's own country presentation of July 2026 states full nationwide automation of civil registration](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-egypt_crvs_transformation_journey.pdf>). It covers 4,571 health offices across 27 governorates, feeding a central births and deaths database in service. No source found since October 2023 puts birth registration at 90% or more. Mature would need a source from the past three years that puts the share of births registered in the digital system at 90% or more.

[A July 2026 presentation describes Ethiopia's national eCRVS as a phased rollout, with a pilot in Addis Ababa, then Amharic-speaking regions, then the rest](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-digitization-ethiopia.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [Addis Ababa launched a digital civil registration system in 50 of its woredas in December 2025](<https://www.ebc.et/english/Home/NewsDetails?NewsId=3422>), replacing 14 years of manual work. [A government statement the same month still called the Addis system a pilot](<https://www.gcs.gov.et/en/2025/12/22/digital-ethiopia-2025-has-brought-about-a-significant-change-in-improving-access-to-civil-registration-and-citizenship-services/>). [In March 2025 the government put birth registration at 37% complete](<https://www.vitalstrategies.org/news/new-initiative-launched-in-ethiopia-to-strengthen-health-data-and-save-lives/>). No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[The Libreville university hospital launched doctoViene, an online birth declaration platform, in June 2024](<https://gabonmailinfos.com/doctoviene-une-application-pour-la-numerisation-des-certificats-de-naissance-au-chul/>). Birth certificates are stored in an electronic database. In the last twelve months, [the Digital Gabon financing agreement, amended from 2 September 2026, funds a fully digital civil registry](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099090226132027563/pdf/P175987-8dfb5a41-ff83-4fc0-a597-c588997e88ba.pdf>) and the digitising of paper records. Nothing found says births are registered digitally beyond that hospital platform, or that deaths are registered digitally. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[At a March 2024 launch the Vice President said Ghana's digital platform allowed real-time registration of births in all regions](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/bawumia-launches-ghana-card-number-at-birth/>). [In June 2025 the registry's reform head described a central digital database deployed in 261 districts](<https://www.newsghana.com.gh/bdr-at-the-centre-of-reform-push-as-minister-for-public-sector-reforms-charts-path-for-improved-data-systems/>). In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 officers in the Eastern Region were still taking digital registration into communities](<https://www.modernghana.com/news/1530759/unicef-bdr-and-kuami-eugene-push-for-improved.html>). No source found since October 2023 says deaths are registered in the digital system. Operating would need deaths registered in the digital system, in service.

[On 24 July 2026 ONECI and NG Tech Innovation signed an MoU on digital identification and civil status](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/07/identite-numerique-loneci-et-ng-tech-innovation-scellent-un-partenariat-strategique-pour-le-rnpp/>). In the last twelve months, [on 28 October 2026 the ministry launched RENEC, the national civil register project](<https://guistat.com/guinee-le-matd-lance-via-loneci-le-projet-renec-pour-moderniser-et-securiser-letat-civil/>), whose first centres open in 2026 and which runs to 2028. [The minister told the CNT that digital solutions reached 28 communes in 2025](<https://matd.gov.gn/plfi-2026-le-matd-passe-devant-la-commission-des-lois-au-cnt/>). [In October 2025 officers from Conakry's 13 communes were shown the first functions of the electronic national register](<https://ravec.gov.gn/constitution-du-registre-national-de-letat-civil-rnec-presentation-des-premieres-fonctionnalites-du-registre-electronique/>). No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[The Registrar General CRVS says an eCRVS system was deployed in Gambia in August 2022](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-gambia.pdf>). [The Registrar General's slides report 1,238,662 births in the eCRVS from August 2022 to March 2025](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/T2-P2-S1-3-Gambia_FINAL.pdf>), shown for every local government area. In the last twelve months, [the count reached over 1.4 million people registered and issued a birth certificate as of June 2026](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-gambia.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says deaths are registered in the digital system. Operating would need deaths registered in the digital system, in service.

[UNICEF says birth registration is done digitally on a tablet platform in hospitals and health centres in Bissau, Tombali and Quinara](<https://www.unicef.org/guineabissau/pt/historias/nascer-com-identidade-nascimentos-registados-nos-servi%C3%A7os-de-sa%C3%BAde-na-guin%C3%A9-bissau>). Over 20,000 children aged 0 to 7 were registered from October 2024 to June 2025. In the last twelve months, [UNDP said in April 2026 that the Santa Luzia Civil Registry Office in Bissau is the first in the country to operate entirely digitally on SIREC](<https://www.undp.org/sites/g/files/zskgke326/files/2026-04/_undp_g.b_newsletter_jan-mar_2026_eng_1.pdf>), with over 2.4 million records digitised. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether births are registered digitally in Equatorial Guinea. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found says civil registration is on paper, or that a digital system has been procured, piloted or rolled out to some offices. Preparing would need a digital civil registration system procured, piloted or rolled out to some offices.

[Identity Week reported that Kenya's digital birth e-service had recorded nearly 300,000 births by October 2026](<https://identityweek.net/birth-registration-e-service-reduces-admin-from-months-to-days/>), over 270,000 of them in the two months to September. In the last twelve months, [the Immigration Principal Secretary said in October 2026 that e-notification would reach all Social Health Authority hospitals by December](<https://www.kenyans.co.ke/news/127644-state-expand-digital-birth-registration-sha-hospitals-within-3-months>). [In November 2026 he told MPs it had been piloted in Nairobi and Bomet](<https://nation.africa/kenya/news/how-kenya-s-digital-birth-registration-system-will-work--5663174>). A nationwide rollout is to follow. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[In August 2024 UNICEF said Liberia's birth registration reaches all 15 counties and 98% of health districts](<https://liberianinvestigator.com/unicef-oic-urges-stronger-collaboration-to-overcome-birth-registration-challenges-in-liberia/>), using tablets, online registration and digital certificates. In the last twelve months, [the government signed a concession with OeSD International in April 2026 for a digital civil registry](<https://newrepubliclib.com/concerns-mount-over-nir-us52m-biometric-id-concession-jeopardizing-jobs-data-and-revenue-security/>), and [in October 2026 it was still before the legislature](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202610/liberian-mps-begin-scrutinizing-ppp-concession-deal-for-new-national-id>). [The proposed concession would record deaths as well as births](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/politics/house-begins-review-of-boakai-s-proposed-national-digital-id-overhaul/article_0c964a7e-9e8c-4c1e-9e05-46bfae096890.html>), but it is not ratified. No source found since October 2023 says deaths are registered in the digital system. Operating would need deaths registered in the digital system, in service.

In the last twelve months, [LANA reported a ministerial meeting on 9 July 2026 on finishing Project Intilaqa and developing the civil registry system](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=361315&lang=ar>). The meeting reviewed completion phases and obstacles, including data cleaning and electronic linkage with other bodies. [The Civil Registry Authority says 257 offices have completed matching and scanning under the project](<https://libyaherald.com/2024/09/pm-aldabaiba-follows-up-on-intilaqa-project-for-matching-civil-registry-electronic-data-with-paper-records>), which matches electronic civil registry data with paper records. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[In August 2026 UNICEF said 30 registration stations in Lesotho run on an SMS-based platform](<https://www.linkedin.com/posts/unicef-lesotho_foreverychild-digitaltransformation-activity-7490765967325597697-36h5>), in health facilities in Maseru, Berea and Leribe. In the last twelve months, the August 2026 report of three districts is the widest coverage found. [A tablet system in Ha-Tankele feeds the social assistance database](<https://lesotho.un.org/en/296588-every-child-counts-linking-nutrition-water-and-identity-better-future>). [The civil registry plans to take digital birth registration nationwide in 2026-2027](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-lesotho.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[In October 2024 the Interior Ministry said over 1,300,000 acts had been declared or issued through the SGEC](<https://aujourdhui.ma/actualite/registre-national-linterieur-renforce-son-dispositif-digital-de-letat-civil>), which handles death declarations as well as births, marriages and divorces. [The Ministry says a new information system for modernising civil status is being installed](<https://www.collectivites-territoriales.gov.ma/fr/programme-de-modernisation-de-letat-civil>). [Interior Minister Laftit ordered the walis of ten regions to speed the digitisation of paper civil-status records](<https://hnews.ma/92028/>), and about 20 million records had been digitised in two regions. The source gives no date for the order. No change has been found in the last twelve months that is dated. No source found since October 2023 puts birth registration at 90% or more. Mature would need a source from the past three years that puts the share of births registered in the digital system at 90% or more.

[In May 2026 Intelligent CIO reported nearly 10 million civil records digitised](<https://www.intelligentcio.com/africa/2026/05/08/ai-powered-digitisation-project-positions-madagascar-as-a-model-for-african-digital-identity-modernisation/>), covering 1,695 communes in 11 regions. In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 the second phase of the Izaho Tokana 2.0 drive was under way, using biometrics](<https://midi-madagasikara.mg/etat-civil-le-projet-de-loif-en-renfort-d-izaho-tokana-2-0/>). [In 2023 the World Bank reported a digital birth registration pilot in Antananarivo and Toamasina](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099122123130031407/pdf/P1694131558e640e51a145152595653587b.pdf>), with over 3,000 newborns registered. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[In December 2024 UNICEF's Mali representative said a project for a platform digitising births, deaths and marriages had been approved](<https://www.unicef.org/mali/en/stories/celebration-progress-birth-registration-mali>), and the National Directorate of Civil Status has identified ten pilot areas. In the last twelve months, [the directorate, DNEC, said in July 2026 that the community birth declaration chain is still on paper](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-decentralisation-mali_0.pdf>). It lists complete digitalisation of the system among its persisting priorities. [In December 2024 UNICEF said 87% of children under one were registered](<https://www.unicef.org/mali/recits/celebration-des-avancees-dans-lenregistrement-des-naissances-au-mali>). No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.

[UNICEF's 2024 brief says all 165 registry offices in Mozambique are digitised](<https://www.unicef.org/mozambique/en/birth-registration-brief>), and 152 of 300 eligible health facilities are linked. [In July 2024 hospital births in some Inhambane districts were linked to e-SIRCEV](<https://www.jornalnoticias.co.mz/destaque/aprimorados-mecanismos-do-registo-de-nascimento/>). In the last twelve months, [by March 2026 the database held 4.57 million people, against a target of 13 million](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099042226205030950/pdf/P172350-ea7be2a4-0727-4372-a851-4df42faaf183.pdf>). [The registry's portal gives coverage of all registration centres as a proposal](<https://civil.registos.gov.mz/crvs/Home/About>), which differs from the 2024 brief. No source found since October 2023 says births are registered digitally across the country. Establishing would need births registered in a digital system in service nationally.
